services_heading: Complete Painting & Decorating Services Across Leicester
services_subhead: From full interior redecoration to exterior painting, wallpapering, and specialist finishes — we handle every detail.

services.title: Interior Painting & Decorating
services.desc: Refresh your living spaces with our interior painting service. We prepare surfaces properly, use quality paints, and leave your home spotless.

services.title: Exterior Painting & Rendering
services.desc: Protect and beautify your property's outside. We paint fascias, soffits, doors, and walls, using weather-resistant products built to last.

services.title: Wallpapering & Wall Coverings
services.desc: Expert wallpaper hanging and removal. Precise patterns, clean edges, and flawless finishes on any room size or style.

services.title: Woodwork & Joinery Finishing
services.desc: Skirting boards, doors, and window frames finished to a professional standard. We sand, prime, and paint for a polished look.

services.title: Preparation & Restoration
services.desc: Proper surface preparation is everything. We strip, sand, and prime all areas to ensure paint adheres and lasts years longer.

services.title: Commercial Painting Services
services.desc: Fast, reliable decoration for offices, retail units, and buildings. We work around your schedule with minimal disruption.

about_pullquote: We take pride in leaving every home looking better than we found it.
about_para_1: Warners Painting & Decorating has been transforming Leicester homes and businesses for over 15 years. We started because we believed that quality decoration shouldn't mean premium prices or endless delays. Today, we've built our reputation on honest work, attention to detail, and turning up when we say we will.
about_para_2: Our customers return to us because we listen, prepare surfaces properly, and use quality materials. Whether you need a bedroom redecorated, a whole house refreshed, or your commercial property given a professional finish, we deliver results that last and prices that don't surprise you.
reviews_heading: What Leicester Customers Say About Warners

reviews.text: Absolutely brilliant job. Warner came round, gave us a fair quote, and got started the following week. Finished the whole lounge and hallway in three days. The attention to detail was spot on — even moved furniture and protected everything. Won't use anyone else.
reviews.author: David C.

reviews.text: Had my kitchen cupboards sprayed and the rest of the kitchen redecorated. Looked a bit sceptical at first but the finish is superb. Very tidy workers, sorted the mess out at the end of each day. Definitely recommend.
reviews.author: Patricia M.

reviews.text: Needed my exterior painted before winter. Warner was professional from the quote to completion. Covered everything, no mess, and the paint's already weathered really well. Happy to recommend to anyone in the Leicester area.
reviews.author: Mark T.
